fields.Name: Materialize List From View
fields.Description: Create a new MJ List from a User View. Thin wrapper around ListOperations.MaterializeFromView. Captures lineage when RememberLineage=true. Cannot produce drops (target is new).

fields.Name: ViewID
fields.Description: The User View whose current results become the new list.

fields.Name: ListName
fields.Description: Name for the new list.

fields.Name: Description
fields.Description: Description for the new list.

fields.Name: CategoryID
fields.Description: List Category to file the new list under.

fields.Name: RememberLineage
fields.Description: Store the source view on the list so it can be refreshed later with Refresh List From Source.

fields.Name: UseSnapshot
fields.Description: Store a snapshot of the view's filter at creation, so later refreshes use that filter even if the view changes.

fields.Name: RefreshMode
fields.Description: How later refreshes apply: 'Additive' (only add) or 'Sync' (add and remove).

fields.Name: CreatedListID
fields.Description: ID of the new list.

fields.Name: Added
fields.Description: Records added to the new list.

fields.Description: Records that could not be added.

fields.Name: Refresh List From Source
fields.Description: Refresh an existing lineage-bearing List against its captured source view (Additive or Sync mode). Sync-mode refreshes that would remove records require ConfirmDrops=true; otherwise rejected with DROP_NOT_CONFIRMED.

fields.Name: ListID
fields.Description: The list to refresh. It must have a source view (lineage).

fields.Name: Mode
fields.Description: 'Additive' adds new matches only; 'Sync' also removes members that no longer match.

fields.Name: ConfirmDrops
fields.Description: Must be true for a Sync refresh that would remove members; otherwise the refresh is rejected with DROP_NOT_CONFIRMED and nothing changes.

fields.Name: Added
fields.Description: Records added.

fields.Name: Removed
fields.Description: Records removed.

fields.Name: Compose Lists
fields.Description: Compose multiple List or View sources into a delta via a set-op (union / intersection / difference). Preview-only by default; supplying a Target projects the result into that list, which can trigger the drop-guard.

fields.Name: Op
fields.Description: Set operation: 'union', 'intersection' or 'difference'.

fields.Name: Inputs
fields.Description: JSON-stringified array of at least 2 ListSource objects to combine. JSON-stringified ListSource: {kind:'list', listId} | {kind:'view', viewId} | {kind:'adhoc', entityName, extraFilter}.

fields.Name: Target
fields.Description: Optional ListSource for the list to write the result into. Omit for a preview that changes nothing. JSON-stringified ListSource: {kind:'list', listId} | {kind:'view', viewId} | {kind:'adhoc', entityName, extraFilter}.

fields.Name: ConfirmDrops
fields.Description: Must be true when writing into Target would remove members.

fields.Name: DeltaToken
fields.Description: Token identifying the computed change set.

fields.Name: Add
fields.Description: Records the result would add to Target.

fields.Name: Remove
fields.Description: Records the result would remove from Target.

fields.Name: Unchanged
fields.Description: Records already in Target.

fields.Name: Warnings
fields.Description: Warnings about the operation (Code, Message).

fields.Name: Added
fields.Description: Records added (only when Target is given).

fields.Description: Records removed (only when Target is given).
